notes.title: GAME RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
Hello to all the players!

We are happy and excited to announce that we has set a date for releasing our game Freediving Hunter Spearfishing the World to the players. The release day will be July 1st 2020. If you are interested in playing the game, please add it to your wish list.

Regards,
Carlos
Strongbox3d, LLC
